notablePrerequisites: Saheeli Rai has at least two loyalty counters on it.
description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Saheeli Rai to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Saheeli Rai's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, creating a token copy of itself that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
Repeat step 2.
